description: Paid: 0.003 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.003 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Discovery Feed: first-party counts of how clients find and probe Agent Weather discovery files and paid routes (windows 1h/24h/7d), with inferred user-agent families and 402-to-paid tallies. Raw readings first; each reading lists its source and time. No client network addresses, wallet addresses, or per-client identifiers. Template URL probes are counted apart from concrete path hits. JSON. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.
